# QuickPetro

> QuickPetro is an Indian industrial services company specializing in thermic fluid system cleaning, filtration, and NABL-accredited heat transfer oil analysis. Founded in 1998 by Dhavalkumar Gandhi, QuickPetro serves 900+ industrial plants across India from its Ahmedabad, Gujarat base.

## About QuickPetro

QuickPetro provides three core services for industrial thermic fluid (heat transfer fluid) systems:

1. **Thermic Fluid Filtration** — Online and offline filtration to 2 microns, removing carbon sludge without plant shutdown.
2. **Thermic Fluid System Cleaning** — Full chemical flushing to remove carbon deposits, restoring 85–95% heat transfer efficiency. Covers full-system cleaning, heat exchanger cleaning, and vessel decontamination.
3. **Thermic Fluid Analysis** — NABL/ISO 17025-accredited laboratory testing across 9 parameters (flash point, viscosity, TAN, insolubles, moisture, sediment, density, color). Ahmedabad hub, coordinated by senior engineer Dhaval Gandhi.
